historical_checkpoint_paths_note: Checkpoint paths are relative to the archived campaign layout at capture; those files are not present in this checkout and these paths are not resumable here.
checkpoint_restart_semantics: PPO checkpoints restore policy/optimizer state, not vector-environment cursors; each allocation attempt starts fresh environments at the train-split beginning.
interpretation: The source lineage contains verified 64-environment, 99,504-step completed train-split episodes for every variant before the current attempt-3 checkpoints. This proves one chronological train-split traversal per environment in that attempt, not all-year active trading, performance, or a valid strategy result. The current resumed attempt has no completion telemetry; its 14M-start baseline has budget for at most 93,750 new steps/environment, so cannot complete a second full split before the 20M cap. Episode trade, breach, and equity fields are training behavior, not final evaluation results. The campaign remains exploratory because the real-market feature-causality audit fails.
